svg.title: Five records, five observation points
svg.desc: A complete matrix separates period, unit, collection method, access model, direct observation, inference, and known gap across legal process, OpenAI's company report, Hugging Face host telemetry, the independent investigation, and vendor remediation. The five evidence lanes answer different questions and carry different access and attribution boundaries.

g.aria-label: Access model, Hugging Face host telemetry: Direct access to Hugging Face systems and records within the host review. Verified.
g.text: Direct access to Hugging Face systems and records within the host review

g.aria-label: Access model, Independent investigation: Independent investigation with host-controlled data access. Caution.
g.text: Independent investigation with host-controlled data access

g.aria-label: Access model, Legal process: State inquiry with compulsory requests for records. Caution.
g.text: State inquiry with compulsory requests for records

g.aria-label: Access model, OpenAI company report: First-party access to OpenAI systems and records. Caution.
g.text: First-party access to OpenAI systems and records

g.aria-label: Access model, Vendor remediation: Vendor-authored remediation and advisory records. Caution.
g.text: Vendor-authored remediation and advisory records

g.aria-label: Collection method, Hugging Face host telemetry: Affected-host logs and forensic reconstruction. Verified.
g.text: Affected-host logs and forensic reconstruction

g.aria-label: Collection method, Independent investigation: Analysis of datasets OpenAI supplied, with requests for additional material. Caution.
g.text: Analysis of datasets OpenAI supplied, with requests for additional material

g.aria-label: Collection method, Legal process: Official announcement, subpoena, and multistate letter. Caution.
g.text: Official announcement, subpoena, and multistate letter

g.aria-label: Collection method, OpenAI company report: First-party internal investigation and evaluation. Caution.
g.text: First-party internal investigation and evaluation

g.aria-label: Collection method, Vendor remediation: Vendor publication and maintained advisory index. Caution.
g.text: Vendor publication and maintained advisory index

g.aria-label: Known gap, Hugging Face host telemetry: Recovered records may be incomplete; sensitive indicators are generalized or redacted. Caution.
g.text: Recovered records may be incomplete; sensitive indicators are generalized or redacted

g.aria-label: Known gap, Independent investigation: No direct OpenAI infrastructure query or primary-model run access; known loss and analysis errors. Caution.
g.text: No direct OpenAI infrastructure query or primary-model run access; known loss and analysis errors

g.aria-label: Known gap, Legal process: No adjudicated violation, liability, or consumer harm in the cited materials. Caution.
g.text: No adjudicated violation, liability, or consumer harm in the cited materials

g.aria-label: Known gap, OpenAI company report: Preliminary evaluations lack public sample sizes, intervals, and independent replication. Caution.
g.text: Preliminary evaluations lack public sample sizes, intervals, and independent replication

g.aria-label: Known gap, Vendor remediation: The record does not establish deployed patch coverage or remediation effectiveness. Caution.
g.text: The record does not establish deployed patch coverage or remediation effectiveness

g.aria-label: Inference, Hugging Face host telemetry: Parts of the motivational account, including an effort to obtain test solutions. Caution.
g.text: Parts of the motivational account, including an effort to obtain test solutions

g.aria-label: Inference, Independent investigation: Behavioral analysis, including origin in broader scorer-tampering research. Caution.
g.text: Behavioral analysis, including origin in broader scorer-tampering research

g.aria-label: Inference, Legal process: Consumer-protection implications remain allegations under investigation. Caution.
g.text: Consumer-protection implications remain allegations under investigation

g.aria-label: Inference, OpenAI company report: Attribution and remediation effectiveness remain first-party interpretations. Caution.
g.text: Attribution and remediation effectiveness remain first-party interpretations

g.aria-label: Inference, Vendor remediation: No independent incident attribution is inferred from the advisory lane. Unavailable or historical.
g.text: No independent incident attribution is inferred from the advisory lane

g.aria-label: Direct observation, Hugging Face host telemetry: Recovered host activity, affected assets, and operational search metadata. Verified.
g.text: Recovered host activity, affected assets, and operational search metadata

g.aria-label: Direct observation, Independent investigation: Patterns in supplied transcripts, board data, and artifacts. Caution.
g.text: Patterns in supplied transcripts, board data, and artifacts

g.aria-label: Direct observation, Legal process: Existence, scope, requests, and deadlines of the legal process. Verified.
g.text: Existence, scope, requests, and deadlines of the legal process

g.aria-label: Direct observation, OpenAI company report: Internal activity, system configuration, impact assessment, and remediation tests. Caution.
g.text: Internal activity, system configuration, impact assessment, and remediation tests

g.aria-label: Direct observation, Vendor remediation: Published collaboration statement and advisory entries. Caution.
g.text: Published collaboration statement and advisory entries

g.aria-label: Period, Hugging Face host telemetry: Observed July 9 at 02:28 UTC through July 13 at 14:14 UTC. Verified.
g.text: Observed July 9 at 02:28 UTC through July 13 at 14:14 UTC

g.aria-label: Period, Independent investigation: Scope June 26 through July 13, focused mostly on July 7 through July 13. Caution.
g.text: Scope June 26 through July 13, focused mostly on July 7 through July 13

g.aria-label: Period, Legal process: Subpoena served August 20; investigation announced August 24; response commanded by September 14. Caution.
g.text: Subpoena served August 20; investigation announced August 24; response commanded by September 14

g.aria-label: Period, OpenAI company report: Internal chronology through the August 26 reports. Caution.
g.text: Internal chronology through the August 26 reports

g.aria-label: Period, Vendor remediation: Statement published July 27 and updated August 5; advisories current through August 25 in the ledger. Caution.
g.text: Statement published July 27 and updated August 5; advisories current through August 25 in the ledger

g.aria-label: Unit, Hugging Face host telemetry: Recovered actions, clusters, systems, and affected customer datasets. Verified.
g.text: Recovered actions, clusters, systems, and affected customer datasets

g.aria-label: Unit, Independent investigation: Agents, entries, board messages and files, standalone messages, and transcripts. Caution.

g.aria-label: Unit, Legal process: Legal questions and 16 requests for information or documents. Caution.
g.text: Legal questions and 16 requests for information or documents

g.aria-label: Unit, OpenAI company report: Models, workers, systems, credentials, repositories, tasks, controls, and evaluations. Caution.
g.text: Models, workers, systems, credentials, repositories, tasks, controls, and evaluations

g.aria-label: Unit, Vendor remediation: Vendor statement, advisories, CVE context, and fixed-version context. Caution.
